# AutoVere

> AutoVere prices a road trip before you drive it: tolls, vignettes, ferries, fuel and EV charging for a specific route, in one indicative total. Google Maps shows the road; AutoVere prices it. Covers 30+ European countries, the United States and Canada, for cars, motorhomes/RVs and motorcycles. A product by KM TECH LABS (Norway).

## What it does

- Routes the trip (OpenStreetMap / OSRM), finds every country and border crossed, and prices each part with that country's own rules.
- Compares three variants: fastest, toll-optimised "Smart Bypass" and 100% toll-free.
- Vehicle class matters: motorhome and motorcycle rates, EV vs petrol/diesel, the driver's own consumption.
- Links to the official vignette and toll portals (e.g. ASFINAG, via.admin.ch, AutoPASS). AutoVere never resells vignettes.
- All figures are indicative planning estimates, not quotes. Drivers should confirm with the official operator.

## Quick answers (2026, indicative, car)

- Norway: no vignette. Tolls are charged automatically by AutoPASS gantries; foreign cars are invoiced via EPASS24. Motorcycles are exempt, EVs pay a reduced rate. Oslo–Bergen is about NOK 410 in tolls on the fastest route (about NOK 230 on the toll-optimised one).
- Austria: digital vignette required on motorways, 10 days EUR 12.80 (motorcycle EUR 5.10).
- Switzerland: annual e-vignette only, CHF 40 (about EUR 42.50); no short-term option.
- Czechia 10-day e-vignette CZK 290 · Slovenia 7-day EUR 16 · Hungary 10-day about EUR 13 · Slovakia 10-day about EUR 12.
- France, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Croatia: pay per kilometre at toll plazas or gantries, no vignette.
- Germany, Netherlands, Belgium, Denmark, Sweden: no motorway tolls for cars. The Storebælt and Øresund bridges are charged separately.

## Data sources

- Norwegian tolls: Statens vegvesen NVDB toll-station register, matched gantry by gantry to the route; ten main fjord ferries (E39, Rv5, Rv63, Fv13) from published 2026 fares
- Fuel prices: EU Weekly Oil Bulletin, Statistics Norway (SSB), US EIA, Statistics Canada
- Currency: European Central Bank reference rates
- EV chargers (US): AFDC / NREL station data
- Routing and geocoding: OSRM, Photon, Nominatim (OpenStreetMap)

## Key pages

- [Road trip planner (Europe)](https://www.autovere.com/): enter start and destination and get the full cost breakdown
- [Tolls & vignettes](https://www.autovere.com/tolls): country-by-country rules and prices
- [Scenic passes & ferries](https://www.autovere.com/scenic)
- [How it works](https://www.autovere.com/how-it-works)
- [FAQ](https://www.autovere.com/faq): accuracy, official prices, comparison with Google Maps
- [Pricing](https://www.autovere.com/pricing): Free, Trip Pass (14 days, one-time), Pro, Business/Fleet
- [USA planner](https://www.autovere.com/us) · [Canada planner](https://www.autovere.com/ca)
- [Norsk](https://www.autovere.com/no) · [Svenska](https://www.autovere.com/se) · [Dansk](https://www.autovere.com/dk) · [Deutsch](https://www.autovere.com/de)
- Route cost pages: [Oslo–Bergen](https://www.autovere.com/no/routes/oslo-bergen), [Oslo–Trondheim](https://www.autovere.com/no/routes/oslo-trondheim), [Oslo–Kristiansand](https://www.autovere.com/no/routes/oslo-kristiansand), [Oslo–Hemsedal](https://www.autovere.com/no/routes/oslo-hemsedal), [Oslo–Geilo](https://www.autovere.com/no/routes/oslo-geilo), [Oslo–Trysil](https://www.autovere.com/no/routes/oslo-trysil), [Oslo–Hafjell](https://www.autovere.com/no/routes/oslo-hafjell), [Bergen–Stavanger](https://www.autovere.com/no/routes/bergen-stavanger), [Bergen–Voss](https://www.autovere.com/no/routes/bergen-voss), [Stavanger–Sirdal](https://www.autovere.com/no/routes/stavanger-sirdal), [Trondheim–Ålesund](https://www.autovere.com/no/routes/trondheim-alesund), [Oslo–Lillehammer](https://www.autovere.com/no/routes/oslo-lillehammer), [Oslo–Røros](https://www.autovere.com/no/routes/oslo-roros), [Oslo–Ålesund](https://www.autovere.com/no/routes/oslo-alesund), [Oslo–Hamburg](https://www.autovere.com/routes/oslo-hamburg), [Munich–Lake Garda](https://www.autovere.com/routes/munich-brenner-lake-garda); all in the [sitemap](https://www.autovere.com/sitemap.xml)
- Open price data (JSON, free to cite with a link): [/api/public/costs](https://www.autovere.com/api/public/costs) — indicative toll ranges for every route page; add `?route=oslo-bergen` for one route. Includes the date the Norwegian toll register was last checked.
